evidence: Tagged with the Tests label and adds script and functional test boundary coverage intended for export to QA script test assets.
rationale: Adds boundary test coverage for the 1,000-item P2SH stack size limit during scriptPubKey execution, filling a gap in existing test vectors. The PR description notes that existing vectors omitted scriptSigs that push the stack to this limit, allowing implementations that skip executing the scriptPubKey to pass. This adds clear value to consensus test coverage and enables bitcoin-core/qa-assets#297, but is reasonably deferrable as it fixes no active bug or test failure in Bitcoin Core.
